full_text:
Shadowing is a wild Meso-Titan whose appearance is that of a silhoutte of a large winged humanoid. He was set to appear in "The Mystery of Shadowing", the cancelled 19th issue of the Huntik comics.

== History ==
Shadowing inspired the famous Mothman legend in the West Virginian city of Point Pleasant, where a famous statue of it exists. [The Mystery of Shadowing]

== Powerbonding ==
Shadowing's true appearance is revealed in its Powerbonded form, with its insectoid head and spiked armor.
